# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print("Raw revenue strings for the 6 invalid rows:", raw_revenue_values)

# Let's look at the first one in detail
first_row = invalid_revenue_completed.iloc[0]
print("Detailed view of first problematic row:")
print("order_id:", first_row['order_id'])
print("revenue (raw):", repr(first_row['revenue']))  # repr shows exact string
print("revenue (stripped):", first_row['revenue'].strip())"}
